en.title: Debussy: String Quartet, Op. 10 – II. Assez vif et bien rythmé
en.overview: This movement is in 6/8 time, and its home key is G major. It is built around one short tune, the "main theme". It first appears in the viola and then moves between the instruments and through many keys. Listen for the tune passing from part to part, and for the mood changing as the music gets louder and softer. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so some labels may be off. Treat "who leads" as a best guess too.

listening_points.headline: Loud opening chords, then a soft drop
listening_points.text: The quartet opens loudly in G major, with the parts moving together in chords [m. 1-2]. The viola then plays the main theme alone [m. 3-4]. Then everything turns soft [m. 5-6].

listening_points.headline: The viola repeats its tune, softer and louder
listening_points.text: The viola plays the theme again and again at the same pitch [m. 7-8]. The other parts then weave around it as separate lines, and the sound drops to very soft [m. 9-11]. The volume swells to medium loud [m. 13-14] and then falls back to soft [m. 17-18].

listening_points.headline: Same tune, now in C major
listening_points.text: The key moves to C major, and the viola keeps playing the theme [m. 19-30]. The others accompany it softly.

listening_points.headline: Biggest surge: the estimated loudest point
listening_points.text: The music grows louder with a crescendo, which means a gradual increase in volume [m. 31]. The key moves to B minor, and the parts play chords together [m. 32-36]. A computer estimate marks the loudest point at [m. 33], at ff (very loud). The loudness then eases off [m. 36].

listening_points.headline: Violin 1 takes the tune; cello answers
listening_points.text: The section marked A tempo begins in D minor and drops to soft [m. 37]. Violin 1 plays the theme, and the other parts move on their own lines [m. 37-42]. The music then builds [m. 41]. Violin 1 keeps the tune over an accompaniment [m. 43-46]. Then the cello takes it, and the sound falls to very soft [m. 47-50].

listening_points.headline: Cello alone, then a new key
listening_points.text: The cello plays solo and very softly [m. 51-53]. The key changes to E-flat major [m. 52]. A new section begins, with sudden soft accents that fade [m. 54-55].

listening_points.headline: Whispered theme in violin 1, then a build
listening_points.text: Violin 1 carries the theme very softly in E-flat major [m. 56-61]. The others accompany it. The sound grows to medium loud [m. 63-64], and the lines become more independent [m. 64-68]. The key slips to C minor near the end [m. 67].

listening_points.headline: Theme again in C major, then a swell to loud
listening_points.text: Violin 1 plays the theme again, now in C major and very softly [m. 70-75]. The music swells [m. 77]. It then turns loud in F minor, and the key goes to E major [m. 78-80]. It returns to F minor and drops to soft chords [m. 81-85].

listening_points.headline: The tune passes viola, violin 2, violin 1
listening_points.text: In A-flat major, the viola brings the theme back softly [m. 86-89]. The key moves to E-flat major and the sound gets louder [m. 90]. Violin 2 then takes the theme in C minor and F minor [m. 94-99]. Violin 1 follows in D minor [m. 100-103].

listening_points.headline: Hushed passage with cello solos
listening_points.text: The key moves to B-flat major and the sound is soft [m. 103]. The music drops to very soft [m. 106]. The cello plays alone, extremely soft (ppp) [m. 108-109]. The key moves to F-sharp major, and there is a sudden loud burst [m. 111]. It drops back to very soft [m. 112]. The cello is alone again [m. 116-117].

listening_points.headline: Loud close of the long middle section
listening_points.text: The key moves to D-flat major. After a soft start, the sound turns suddenly loud [m. 118-119]. A trio, meaning three players, is heard [m. 120-121]. The section ends with loud chords in all parts [m. 122-123]. Who leads here is uncertain.

listening_points.headline: New section: wandering keys, then a loud climb
listening_points.text: A new section starts softly in F-sharp minor. The key then passes through B major and E major, and it grows louder at [m. 129]. The lines become separate in B minor [m. 136-139]. The music turns loud in D major [m. 140], with parts in octaves at [m. 142] and [m. 144]. The octaves are the same notes at different heights. It fades to a cello solo [m. 146-147].

listening_points.headline: Back to G major, but unsettled
listening_points.text: G major returns, very softly [m. 148]. The leader here is probably violin 1, but this is uncertain. The music swells to loud at [m. 156]. The key then turns to F minor [m. 158], then F-sharp minor [m. 161], and finally D minor [m. 166]. The sound fades to very soft at the end [m. 164-167].

listening_points.headline: Quiet ending in G major
listening_points.text: A new time signature starts the last section, and the cello is mostly alone, very softly [m. 168-172]. The key settles on G major [m. 171]. The parts play chords together, extremely soft (ppp) and then very soft (pp) [m. 173-175]. The movement ends extremely softly (ppp), with the parts in octaves [m. 176-177].

glossary.explanation: The short tune that opens the movement and keeps coming back, in different instruments and keys.
The home note and scale that the music feels built around. Major keys sound brighter. Minor keys sound darker.
The parts move together, like chords under a tune.
The same note played at different heights by different instruments.
Three instruments play at the same time.
ff means very loud. ppp means extremely soft.

zh.title: 德彪西：G小调弦乐四重奏，Op.10 – 第二乐章（Assez vif et bien rythmé）导听
zh.overview: 这是一个6/8拍的乐章，共177小节，主调是G大调。开头由中提琴奏出一个短小的主题，之后它会在不同乐器和不同的调里一再出现。请留意主题由谁演奏、声音是强还是弱、调是否改变。本导听中的调和和弦都是电脑自动估计的，可能有误。乐章最后在G大调上安静地结束。

listening_points.headline: 强奏开场，各声部齐步前进
listening_points.text: 乐章在G大调上以强（f）开始。[m. 1-2] 四件乐器节奏一致，是主调织体（一个声部带旋律，其余声部同步配合）。第一小提琴和大提琴可能是领头声部，但把握不大。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴独奏，主题第一次出现
listening_points.text: [m. 3-4] 中提琴独自奏出主要主题，其他声部不出声。此处力度仍是强。[m. 4] 标有渐弱，声音逐渐变轻。

listening_points.headline: 轻声的和声，再由中提琴重复主题
listening_points.text: [m. 5-6] 声音减弱到弱（p），四个声部再次一起行进。[m. 7-8] 中提琴再次独奏主题，力度为中强（mf）。[m. 8] 又有渐弱。

listening_points.headline: 主题在很弱的声音中反复
listening_points.text: [m. 9-18] 中提琴一遍遍重复主题。[m. 9] 起力度很弱（pp），此处各声部是各走各的线条（独立声部）。[m. 13] 标有渐强，到[m. 14]达到中强（mf）。[m. 17] 又回到弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 转到C大调，中提琴继续主题
listening_points.text: [m. 19] 估计调性换成C大调。中提琴依然奏主题，其余声部伴奏。力度大多保持弱（p），[m. 23] 短暂变为中强（mf）。

listening_points.headline: 渐强推向全乐章最响处
listening_points.text: [m. 31] 力度为强（f），并标有渐强。[m. 32] 估计转入B小调。[m. 33] 达到很强（ff），分析认为这是全乐章最响最忙的点（电脑估计）。[m. 36] 开始渐弱。

listening_points.headline: A tempo：第一小提琴奏出主题
listening_points.text: [m. 37] 进入第二部分（A tempo），估计调为D小调，力度弱（p），并标有渐强。第一小提琴领头奏主题。这时的主题比开头高了两个八度。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴接过主题，声音变得很弱
listening_points.text: [m. 47-50] 主题交给大提琴，比开头低一个八度，其他声部伴奏。[m. 49] 起声音变得很弱（pp）。[m. 51-53] 大提琴独奏。[m. 52] 估计转入降E大调。

listening_points.headline: 第三部分：很弱的降E大调主题
listening_points.text: [m. 54] 进入新的第三部分（换了调号）。[m. 56] 起第一小提琴在很弱（pp）的声音中奏出主题。[m. 59]和[m. 63]有渐强标记，[m. 64]升到中强（mf），声部变为各走各的线条。

listening_points.headline: C大调再现主题，随后调性快速变化
listening_points.text: [m. 69-76] 估计回到C大调，第一小提琴在很弱的声音中再次奏主题。[m. 77] 起有渐强，到[m. 78]达到强（f）。接着调性估计快速变化，[m. 79]为E大调，[m. 81]为F小调，[m. 83]力度变弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 主题在中提琴、第二、第一小提琴间传递
listening_points.text: [m. 86-89] 中提琴在估计的降A大调里奏主题，力度弱。[m. 94-99] 第二小提琴接着奏主题，[m. 98]变为中强（mf）。[m. 100-103] 第一小提琴再奏主题。

listening_points.headline: 变得极弱，大提琴独奏，再突然转强
listening_points.text: [m. 103] 估计转入降B大调，力度弱（p）。[m. 108] 大提琴独奏，力度极弱（ppp）。[m. 109] 估计转入升F大调。[m. 111] 声音突然变强（f）。[m. 117] 估计到降D大调，[m. 119] 再次突然变强（f）。

listening_points.headline: 第四部分：调性变动，最后渐弱
listening_points.text: [m. 124] 进入第四部分，估计为升F小调，力度弱（p）。这里领头声部不明确，可能是第一小提琴。[m. 129] 估计为E大调，有渐强。[m. 140] 变强（f），[m. 142] 出现齐奏（各声部同音或八度）。[m. 146-147] 大提琴独奏，很弱（pp）。

listening_points.headline: 第五部分：回到G大调，力度起伏大
listening_points.text: [m. 148] 进入第五部分，估计回到G大调，力度很弱（pp）。领头声部不确定，可能是第一小提琴。[m. 156] 变强（f）。[m. 158] 估计转为F小调，[m. 161] 为升F小调。[m. 164] 又变得很弱（pp），[m. 166] 估计为D小调。

listening_points.headline: 尾声：换拍号，在G大调上轻轻收束
listening_points.text: [m. 168] 进入第六部分，拍号改变，大提琴独奏，力度很弱（pp）。[m. 171] 估计回到G大调。[m. 173] 声音更弱（ppp），四声部一起行进。[m. 176-177] 以齐奏结束，力度仍是极弱（ppp）。

glossary.explanation: 全乐章反复出现的短小旋律。这里先由中提琴奏出，之后换乐器、换调再次出现。
调是一段音乐的“中心音”和色彩。转调就是中心换了。本导听中的调都是电脑估计的。
一个声部带旋律，其他声部节奏相近地配合。
各声部各走各的线条，没有明显的主次。
只有一件乐器在演奏，其他声部不出声。
各声部演奏同一个音，或相隔八度的相同旋律。
声音逐渐变大或变小。只有谱上标有渐强或渐弱时才是逐渐变化，否则是突然变化。

glossary.term: 力度 (ppp, pp, p, mf, f, ff)
glossary.explanation: 表示声音大小。ppp 最弱，pp 很弱，p 弱，mf 中强，f 强，ff 很强。
